```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
direct = "../VASP/Si2_149/static/dense/"
import json
tag = "feb25_loop0_07_noopt"
with open(direct+"all_wannier_data" + tag+".json", 'r') as f:
    wan0_noopt = json.load(f)
tag = "feb25_loop3_07_noopt"
with open(direct+"all_wannier_data" + tag+".json", 'r') as f:
    wan3_noopt = json.load(f)
tag = "feb25_loop0_07_orth"
with open(direct+"all_wannier_data" + tag+".json", 'r') as f:
    wan3_orth = json.load(f)
#print(wan0_noopt)
plots = []
num_orbs = len(wan0_noopt)
print(num_orbs)
init_orbs = []
wan0_orbs = []
wan3_orbs = []
orth_orbs = []
best_orbs = []
for orb in range(num_orbs):
    init_orbs.append(wan0_noopt[orb][1])
    wan0_orbs.append(wan0_noopt[orb][0])
    wan3_orbs.append(wan3_noopt[orb][0])
    best_orbs.append(wan3_noopt[orb][2])
    orth_orbs.append(wan3_orth[orb][0])
    

# plot orbitals
for orb in range(num_orbs):
    wan0_max = np.amax(np.abs(wan0_orbs[orb][1]))
    wan3_max = np.amax(np.abs(wan3_orbs[orb][1]))
    best_max = np.amax(np.abs(best_orbs[orb][1]))
    init_max = np.amax(np.abs(init_orbs[orb][1]))
    orth_max = np.amax(np.abs(orth_orbs[orb][1]))
    wan0_diff = wan0_orbs[orb][1]/wan0_max - init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max
    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    #plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
    #ax.plot(wan0_orbs[orb][0], wan0_orbs[orb][1]/wan0_max, "red",label="wannier")
    #ax.plot(wan3_orbs[orb][0], wan3_orbs[orb][1]/wan3_max, "blue",label="cogito")
    ax.plot(best_orbs[orb][0], best_orbs[orb][1]/best_max, "green",label="new atomic fit")
    ax.plot(np.array(init_orbs[orb][0])+2.368, init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max,"--",  "black",alpha=0.4)
    ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max, "black",label="initial fit")
    #ax.plot(orth_orbs[orb][0], orth_orbs[orb][1]/orth_max, "pink",label="orthogonal")
    
    #ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], wan0_diff, '--',"black")
    ax.set_xlim((-4,4))
    #ax.set_ylim((np.amin(og_vals1)-np.amax(og_vals1)*0.2,np.amax(og_vals1)*1.2))
    ax.set_xlabel("Distance along line (Å)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Orbital magnitude")
    ax.set_title("Orbital Magnitude vs. Distance")
    ax.legend()
    #plt.grid(True)
    plots.append(fig)
    plt.show()
    #all_data.append([[list(wan_dists1.real), list(wan_vals1.real)],[list(og_dists1.real), list(og_vals1.real)],[list(new_dists1.real), list(new_vals1.real)]])
    plt.close()
    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(wan0_orbs[orb][0], wan0_orbs[orb][1]/wan0_max, "red",label="wannier")
    #ax.plot(wan3_orbs[orb][0], wan3_orbs[orb][1]/wan3_max, "blue",label="cogito")
    ax.plot(best_orbs[orb][0], best_orbs[orb][1]/best_max, "green",label="new atomic fit")
    ax.plot(np.array(init_orbs[orb][0])+2.368, init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max,"--", "black",alpha=0.4)
    ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max, "black",label="initial fit")
    ax.plot(orth_orbs[orb][0], orth_orbs[orb][1]/orth_max, "pink",label="orthogonal")
    
    # Fill the area between the two lines
    ax.fill_between(wan0_orbs[orb][0], init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max, wan0_orbs[orb][1]/wan0_max, color='red', alpha=0.4)

    #ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], wan0_diff, '--',"black")
    ax.set_xlim((-4,4))
    #ax.set_ylim((np.amin(og_vals1)-np.amax(og_vals1)*0.2,np.amax(og_vals1)*1.2))
    ax.set_xlabel("Distance along line (Å)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Orbital magnitude")
    ax.set_title("Orbital Magnitude vs. Distance")
    ax.legend()
    #plt.grid(True)
    plots.append(fig)
    plt.show()
    #all_data.append([[list(wan_dists1.real), list(wan_vals1.real)],[list(og_dists1.real), list(og_vals1.real)],[list(new_dists1.real), list(new_vals1.real)]])
    plt.close()

    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    #ax.plot(wan0_orbs[orb][0], wan0_orbs[orb][1]/wan0_max, "red",label="wannier")
    ax.plot(wan3_orbs[orb][0], wan3_orbs[orb][1]/wan3_max, "blue",label="cogito")
    ax.plot(best_orbs[orb][0], best_orbs[orb][1]/best_max, "green",label="new atomic fit")
    ax.plot(np.array(init_orbs[orb][0])+2.368, init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max,"--",  "black",alpha=0.4)
    ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max, "black",label="initial fit")
    #ax.plot(orth_orbs[orb][0], orth_orbs[orb][1]/orth_max, "pink",label="orthogonal")
    # Fill the area between the two lines
    ax.fill_between(wan0_orbs[orb][0], init_orbs[orb][1]/init_max, wan3_orbs[orb][1]/wan3_max, color='blue', alpha=0.4)
    
    #ax.plot(init_orbs[orb][0], wan0_diff, '--',"black")
    ax.set_xlim((-4,4))
    #ax.set_ylim((np.amin(og_vals1)-np.amax(og_vals1)*0.2,np.amax(og_vals1)*1.2))
    ax.set_xlabel("Distance along line (Å)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Orbital magnitude")
    ax.set_title("Orbital Magnitude vs. Distance")
    ax.legend()
    #plt.grid(True)
    plots.append(fig)
    plt.show()
    #all_data.append([[list(wan_dists1.real), list(wan_vals1.real)],[list(og_dists1.real), list(og_vals1.real)],[list(new_dists1.real), list(new_vals1.real)]])
    plt.close()
```
